big: Nifty Media is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Media track?
The Nifty Media Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the Media & Entertainment sector including printing and publishing. It holds 10 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
